newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Friday conducted a round of special purchase and resale agreements in the money market at 3.25 percent, dealers said.
The central bank intervened after the call loan, or overnight lending rate, traded at the top of the Bank of Canada's 2.75-3.25 percent target range

"Call has been trading pretty easy for most of the day. It's been 2.95 to 3.0 percent. Basically at the end of the day here it's just all of a sudden seems to have completely dried up. Call immediately went to 3.25 percent. The bank is just in protecting the upper end of the band," said one trader.
The call loan rate remained bid at 3.25 percent in the wake of the intervention, analysts said. The three-month when-issued T-bill traded with a yield of 2.91 percent.
